description: S45 T4 (PM1) over the T12 (PM15) engine door: policy.seedCorpus is a THIN method over policyseed.ApplyCorpus — the same engine path seed.apply and the CLI verb use. The per-agent counts are the door's honest pair (seeded + unchanged always add up to the agent's corpus rules — a count never silently omits what was left alone); dryRun:true writes NOTHING and audits NOTHING (a dry run is a read — no policy rows, no policy_change row, no RecordAuthored), and a second real run of the same corpus returns dryRun:false with everything under unchanged and audits nothing new (idempotence, D4's convergence). The ONE per-run policy_change row (op='seed') is written by T12's own door beside the engine's seed_event — this answer never implies a second one.
